Summary
The Database Administrator will be responsible for managing and optimizing SQL Server environments to ensure high availability, performance, and operational stability. The role includes administering HA SQL clusters, performing backup and restore operations, tuning database performance, and ensuring secure and
reliable data handling across the organization. The ideal candidate must demonstrate strong technical expertise and the ability to support mission-critical database systems.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage and maintain HA SQL clusters to ensure continuous availability.
• Perform backup, restore, and recovery operations with best practices.
• Conduct performance tuning and optimization for SQL Server databases.
• Monitor database health, security, and performance metrics.
• Collaborate with application and infrastructure teams to support database needs.
• Troubleshoot complex SQL issues and provide timely resolutions.
• Maintain accurate documentation, processes, and database standards.

Job Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Strong expertise in HA SQL clusters, backup/restore operations, and performance tuning.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
• Microsoft SQL Server certification or equivalent (required).

Description

Job Summary:

The Database Administrator will play a crucial role in the administration of systems infrastructure within our esteemed government entity. Reporting directly to the IT Systems Manager, the incumbent is expected to bring expertise in Microsoft and Oracle database administration, ensuring the seamless functioning of critical databases.

Senior Geospatial Database Administrator

Salary: Competitive

Grade: 6

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

JOB PURPOSE

BAE Systems is the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor under the Government-to-Government arrangements that are in place to provide equipment, support and training to Saudi Arabia. We provide maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and train RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel safely in a training environment in how to use their aircraft, equipment and weapons.

BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda including Saudisation and the training and development of Saudi National capability through the growth of the Saudi National Partner Companies thereby reinforcing Industrialisation and Partnerships.

The Senior Geospatial Database Administrator is responsible for maintaining and managing geospatial databases to ensure data integrity and security. The purpose of this role is to manage data identification, acquisition, management, and maintenance to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient collection, analysis, and dissemination of geospatial data. The Individual should be able to work well unsupervised and will be able to plan and organise the team’s activities.

JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES

· Develops and delivers training programs on geospatial tools and technologies.

· Ensures that users have the necessary knowledge and skills to operate geospatial tools and technologies effectively and efficiently.

· Collaborates with other geospatial specialists to develop training materials.

· Applies analytical and creative skills to develop optimal training programs.

· Monitors and evaluates training effectiveness to ensure high-quality learning outcomes.

· Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of geospatial training platforms and tools.

· Provides support to the GDMS team, prepares the required Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), training and reports related to his duties.

· Leading the team necessary for its tasks as directed by the Line manager.

· Take a pro-active approach to planning and organising across multiple areas and an ability to communicate effectively across all RSAF Directorates, Depots, Operating Bases and Contractors.

· Develop a sound understanding of the Customer’s requirements and priorities and be able to make informed decisions based on this understanding.

· Manage financial issues on behalf of the RSAF fleet comprising of different aircraft variants, in several configurations, across a widely dispersed location, under stringent funding constraints.

RECRUITMENT SPECIFICATION

Essential

· Master’s degree in Geospatial Information, or a related field.

· ESRI ArcGlS Enterprise Administration Professional Certification, ESRl Enterprise Geodata Management Professional Certification, or equivalent.

· Extensive experience in geospatial database management or administration roles.

· Experience working with GIS server software, preferably ESR, ArcGtS and Open Source.

· Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Line.

· Customer Services Manager/Geospatial Services Center

EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

In return for the required high levels of commitment and hard work you will receive a competitive salary, rent free accommodation and access to free recreation facilities, all available within Company secured accommodation. In addition, a generous leave and travel allowance makes this an opportunity not to be missed.

On successfully securing a role your appointment to Saudi Arabia will initially be on single status. On commencement of employment in Saudi Arabia you will have the opportunity to apply to have your family join you in the future. A full health care scheme is provided within Saudi Arabia.

SAUDI NATIONAL EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

In return for the required high levels of commitment and hard work you will receive a competitive salary and benefits package, including a generous leave and travel allowance, a full health care scheme and access to subsidised recreational facilities

BAE Systems

At BAE Systems, we provide some of the world’s most advanced, technology-led defence, aerospace and security solutions. We employ a skilled workforce of 89,600 people in more than 40 countries. Working with customers and local partners, we develop, engineer, manufacture, and support products and systems to deliver military capability, protect national security and people, and keep critical information and infrastructure secure.

All appointments in Saudi Arabia are subject to receipt of all necessary Government and/or Customer approvals.

They undertake complex operational activities including drafting ZATCA IT systems and database operations guidelines and standards. Leading the installation, configuration and upgrades of software, hardware, operating systems and processes as planned. Supervising the implementation of operations and security patches as well as vendors’ release notes. Troubleshooting and identifying root causes, providing technical support for complex incidents and tickets. ABOUT CoorB

We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a skilled Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA) with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in administering Microsoft SQL Server environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SQL Server Failover Cluster Instances (FCI), Always On Availability Groups, backup and recovery, performance tuning, and high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and reliability of mission-critical SQL Server databases.

YOU WILL

• Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server instances.

• Administer SQL Server environments across Development, Test, UAT, and Production.

• Design, implement, configure, and support SQL Server Failover Cluster Instances (FCI).

• Configure, administer, and troubleshoot Always On Availability Groups.

• Perform planned failover, disaster recovery testing, and high availability validation.

• Monitor SQL Server performance, availability, and capacity using monitoring tools.

• Manage database backup, restore, and disaster recovery using SQL Server native tools and maintenance strategies.

• Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, and index management.

• Troubleshoot database, replication, clustering, and Always On-related issues.

• Implement database security, user management, encryption, auditing, and compliance controls.

• Automate routine DBA tasks using PowerShell, T-SQL, SQL Server Agent, or scripting tools.

• Support database migrations, upgrades, and version compatibility assessments.

• Work closely with infrastructure, application, and support teams to resolve production issues.

• Prepare and maintain database architecture, operational procedures, and disaster recovery documentation

Requirements
TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THE ROLE YOU NEED
• Minimum 5 years of Microsoft SQL Server Database Administration experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with SQL Server 2016, 2017, 2019, or 2022.

• Proven expertise in SQL Server Failover Cluster Instances (FCI).

• Strong experience implementing and supporting Always On Availability Groups.

• Experience with Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).

• Strong knowledge of SQL Server backup, restore, recovery, and maintenance strategies.

• Experience with database performance tuning, execution plans, indexing, and statistics.

• Strong T-SQL programming and troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with SQL Server Agent, Database Mail, Maintenance Plans, and SQL Profiler/Extended Events.

• Experience with PowerShell scripting for SQL Server administration.

• Knowledge of database security, encryption, Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), and auditing.

• Experience working on Windows Server environments.
